WITH 
-- Total runs scored per player
runs_per_player AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),

-- Balls faced per player
balls_faced_per_player AS (
    SELECT striker as player_id, COUNT(*) as balls_faced
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY striker
),

-- Dismissals per player
dismissals_per_player AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken
    WHERE player_out IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_out
),

-- Wickets taken per player
wickets_per_player AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken
    WHERE player_out IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_out
),

-- Runs conceded per bowler (from balls bowled)
runs_conceded_balls AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as balls_runs, COUNT(*) as balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),

-- Extras conceded per bowler
extras_conceded AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id, SUM(er.extra_runs) as extras_runs, COUNT(*) as extra_balls
    FROM extra_runs er
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON er.match_id = bb.match_id AND er.over_id = bb.over_id AND er.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND er.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    WHERE er.extra_runs IS NOT NULL AND bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),

-- Total runs conceded per bowler (balls + extras)
total_conceded AS (
    SELECT rc.player_id, rc.balls_runs + COALESCE(ec.extras_runs, 0) as total_runs_conceded, rc.balls_bowled
    FROM runs_conceded_balls rc
    LEFT JOIN extras_conceded ec ON rc.player_id = ec.player_id
),

-- Economy rate per bowler (keep balls_bowled too)
economy_per_player AS (
    SELECT player_id, total_runs_conceded, balls_bowled, (total_runs_conceded * 6.0) / balls_bowled as economy_rate
    FROM total_conceded
),

-- Most frequent role per player
role_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) as role_count
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
most_frequent_role AS (
    SELECT player_id, role as most_frequent_role
    FROM (
        SELECT player_id, role, role_count,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY role_count DESC) as rn
        FROM role_counts
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),

-- Highest score per player
highest_scores AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_in_match, bb.match_id
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
highest_score_per_player AS (
    SELECT player_id, MAX(runs_in_match) as highest_score
    FROM highest_scores
    GROUP BY player_id
),

-- Runs per match for 30/50/100 counting
runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, bb.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_in_match
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
match_counts_30_50_100 AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN runs_in_match >= 30 THEN 1 END) as matches_30plus,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN runs_in_match >= 50 THEN 1 END) as matches_50plus,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN runs_in_match >= 100 THEN 1 END) as matches_100plus
    FROM runs_per_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),

-- Best bowling performance per player (most wickets in a match, tie-break by fewest runs)
bowler_match_perf AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id, bb.match_id,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN wt.player_out IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as wickets,
           SUM(bs.runs_scored) as balls_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
extras_per_match AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id, bb.match_id, SUM(er.extra_runs) as extras_runs
    FROM extra_runs er
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON er.match_id = bb.match_id AND er.over_id = bb.over_id AND er.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND er.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    WHERE er.extra_runs IS NOT NULL AND bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT bmp.player_id, 
           bmp.wickets, 
           bmp.balls_runs + COALESCE(epm.extras_runs, 0) as runs_conceded,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bmp.player_id ORDER BY bmp.wickets DESC, (bmp.balls_runs + COALESCE(epm.extras_runs, 0)) ASC) as rn
    FROM bowler_match_perf bmp
    LEFT JOIN extras_per_match epm ON bmp.player_id = epm.player_id AND bmp.match_id = epm.match_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    mfr.most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(rpp.total_runs, 0) as total_runs_scored,
    COALESCE(dp.total_dismissals, 0) as total_dismissals,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(dp.total_dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(rpp.total_runs, 0) * 1.0 / dp.total_dismissals ELSE 0 END as batting_average,
    COALESCE(hsp.highest_score, 0) as highest_score,
    COALESCE(mcc.matches_30plus, 0) as matches_30plus,
    COALESCE(mcc.matches_50plus, 0) as matches_50plus,
    COALESCE(mcc.matches_100plus, 0) as matches_100plus,
    COALESCE(bfp.balls_faced, 0) as total_balls_faced,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(bfp.balls_faced, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(rpp.total_runs, 0) * 100.0 / bfp.balls_faced ELSE 0 END as strike_rate,
    COALESCE(wp.total_wickets, 0) as total_wickets_taken,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(cep.balls_bowled, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(cep.total_runs_conceded, 0) * 6.0 / cep.balls_bowled ELSE 0 END as economy_rate,
    bbp.wickets || '-' || bbp.runs_conceded as best_bowling_performance
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
LEFT JOIN runs_per_player rpp ON p.player_id = rpp.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals_per_player dp ON p.player_id = dp.player_id
LEFT JOIN highest_score_per_player hsp ON p.player_id = hsp.player_id
LEFT JOIN match_counts_30_50_100 mcc ON p.player_id = mcc.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls_faced_per_player bfp ON p.player_id = bfp.player_id
LEFT JOIN wickets_per_player wp ON p.player_id = wp.player_id
LEFT JOIN economy_per_player cep ON p.player_id = cep.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling bbp ON p.player_id = bbp.player_id AND bbp.rn = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id

# Special Words Definition

## Batting Average
- Batting average is a measure of a batsman's performance, calculated by dividing the total number of runs scored by the number of times they have been dismissed. A higher batting average indicates a more consistent and successful batsman.
- Batting Average = Total Runs ÷ Total Dismissals

## Strike Rate
- In batting, strike rate indicates the scoring rate of a batsman, showing the average number of runs scored per 100 balls faced. A higher strike rate reflects an aggressive and fast-scoring batsman.
- Strike Rate = (Total Runs ÷ Balls Faced) × 100

## Wickets Taken
- Wickets taken refers to the total number of times a bowler has successfully dismissed an opposing batsman. This statistic is a core measure of a bowler's effectiveness and impact on the game.

## Economy Rate
- Economy rate measures a bowler's efficiency by indicating the average number of runs conceded per over (6 balls) bowled. A lower economy rate shows greater control and efficiency in restricting the opposition's scoring.
- Economy Rate = (Total Runs Conceded ÷ Balls Bowled) × 6

## Wickets Taken
- The number of times a bowler successfully dismisses a batsman in a single match.  This metric is a direct indicator of the bowler's effectiveness, showing how many players they were able to remove from play.

## Runs Given
- The total number of runs scored by the batting side off a particular bowler’s deliveries in a single match.  This value reflects the runs the bowler has conceded to the batting team, and a lower runs-given value is typically favorable for the bowler's performance.

WITH 
-- Total runs scored per player
runs_per_player AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker
),

-- Balls faced per player
balls_faced_per_player AS (
    SELECT striker as player_id, COUNT(*) as balls_faced
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY striker
),

-- Dismissals per player
dismissals_per_player AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken
    WHERE player_out IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_out
),

-- Wickets taken per player
wickets_per_player AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken
    WHERE player_out IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_out
),

-- Runs conceded per bowler (from balls bowled)
runs_conceded_balls AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as balls_runs, COUNT(*) as balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),

-- Extras conceded per bowler
extras_conceded AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id, SUM(er.extra_runs) as extras_runs, COUNT(*) as extra_balls
    FROM extra_runs er
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON er.match_id = bb.match_id AND er.over_id = bb.over_id AND er.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND er.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    WHERE er.extra_runs IS NOT NULL AND bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),

-- Total runs conceded per bowler (balls + extras)
total_conceded AS (
    SELECT rc.player_id, rc.balls_runs + COALESCE(ec.extras_runs, 0) as total_runs_conceded, rc.balls_bowled
    FROM runs_conceded_balls rc
    LEFT JOIN extras_conceded ec ON rc.player_id = ec.player_id
),

-- Economy rate per bowler (keep balls_bowled too)
economy_per_player AS (
    SELECT player_id, total_runs_conceded, balls_bowled, (total_runs_conceded * 6.0) / balls_bowled as economy_rate
    FROM total_conceded
),

-- Most frequent role per player
role_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) as role_count
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
most_frequent_role AS (
    SELECT player_id, role as most_frequent_role
    FROM (
        SELECT player_id, role, role_count,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY role_count DESC) as rn
        FROM role_counts
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),

-- Highest score per player
highest_scores AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_in_match, bb.match_id
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
highest_score_per_player AS (
    SELECT player_id, MAX(runs_in_match) as highest_score
    FROM highest_scores
    GROUP BY player_id
),

-- Runs per match for 30/50/100 counting
runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT bb.striker as player_id, bb.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_in_match
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
match_counts_30_50_100 AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN runs_in_match >= 30 THEN 1 END) as matches_30plus,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN runs_in_match >= 50 THEN 1 END) as matches_50plus,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN runs_in_match >= 100 THEN 1 END) as matches_100plus
    FROM runs_per_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),

-- Best bowling performance per player (most wickets in a match, tie-break by fewest runs)
bowler_match_perf AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id, bb.match_id,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN wt.player_out IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as wickets,
           SUM(bs.runs_scored) as balls_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
extras_per_match AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler as player_id, bb.match_id, SUM(er.extra_runs) as extras_runs
    FROM extra_runs er
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON er.match_id = bb.match_id AND er.over_id = bb.over_id AND er.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND er.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    WHERE er.extra_runs IS NOT NULL AND bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, bb.match_id
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT bmp.player_id, 
           bmp.wickets, 
           bmp.balls_runs + COALESCE(epm.extras_runs, 0) as runs_conceded,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bmp.player_id ORDER BY bmp.wickets DESC, (bmp.balls_runs + COALESCE(epm.extras_runs, 0)) ASC) as rn
    FROM bowler_match_perf bmp
    LEFT JOIN extras_per_match epm ON bmp.player_id = epm.player_id AND bmp.match_id = epm.match_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    mfr.most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(rpp.total_runs, 0) as total_runs_scored,
    COALESCE(dp.total_dismissals, 0) as total_dismissals,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(dp.total_dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(rpp.total_runs, 0) * 1.0 / dp.total_dismissals ELSE 0 END as batting_average,
    COALESCE(hsp.highest_score, 0) as highest_score,
    COALESCE(mcc.matches_30plus, 0) as matches_30plus,
    COALESCE(mcc.matches_50plus, 0) as matches_50plus,
    COALESCE(mcc.matches_100plus, 0) as matches_100plus,
    COALESCE(bfp.balls_faced, 0) as total_balls_faced,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(bfp.balls_faced, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(rpp.total_runs, 0) * 100.0 / bfp.balls_faced ELSE 0 END as strike_rate,
    COALESCE(wp.total_wickets, 0) as total_wickets_taken,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(cep.balls_bowled, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(cep.total_runs_conceded, 0) * 6.0 / cep.balls_bowled ELSE 0 END as economy_rate,
    bbp.wickets || '-' || bbp.runs_conceded as best_bowling_performance
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
LEFT JOIN runs_per_player rpp ON p.player_id = rpp.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals_per_player dp ON p.player_id = dp.player_id
LEFT JOIN highest_score_per_player hsp ON p.player_id = hsp.player_id
LEFT JOIN match_counts_30_50_100 mcc ON p.player_id = mcc.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls_faced_per_player bfp ON p.player_id = bfp.player_id
LEFT JOIN wickets_per_player wp ON p.player_id = wp.player_id
LEFT JOIN economy_per_player cep ON p.player_id = cep.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling bbp ON p.player_id = bbp.player_id AND bbp.rn = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id
